title: Add a CSV formatter and a table formatter, plus an integration test
text:
Add two independent formatters for the records in src/records.js, then
one test that uses both.

1. src/csv.js exports toCsv(records). The first line is the header
   "id,name,score". Then one line per record with the three values in
   that order joined by commas. Lines are joined with a single newline
   and there is no trailing newline.

2. src/table.js exports toTable(records). The first line is
   "id | name | score", the second line is "---", then one line per
   record with the three values joined by " | ". Lines are joined with a
   single newline and there is no trailing newline.

3. test/integration.test.js requires both formatters and sampleRecords()
   from src/records.js and asserts that the table has exactly one more
   line than the CSV (the separator row).

The two formatters do not import each other.
